name: Mimesis – Ukulingisa
subtitle: Dlala, qagela, hleka
promotionalText: Okusha: izihloko ezi-5 ezilula (Izilwane, Imisebenzi, Ezemidlalo, Izenzo zansuku zonke, Ukudla neziphuzo) nezisho zangempela zolimi lwakho. Mahhala, azikho izikhangiso.
description:
Mimesis ngumdlalo we-charades we-mime wabangane, umndeni, noma abantu ababili. Ifoni eyodwa, amazwi awukho: ulingisa ikhadi, iqembu lakho likhomba impendulo, kanti isibali siqhubeka.

IMODI YABABILI
Nababili? Nibashintshana ukulingisa. Ikhadi ngalinye lithola amaphuzu womabili: umdlali ophatha i-mime uthola amaphuzu angu-2, umqageli athola 1. Owuqala ukufinyelela inani elibekiwe uyawina. Kufanelekile ezithandwaneni, kubafowethu nodadewethu noma umdlalo omfushane esihlalweni.

INDLELA EYISEBENZAYO
Hlukanisa amaqembu (noma khetha abadlali ababili). Ku-turn yakho, bamba ifoni ukuze abanye bangayiboni, ufunde ikhadi bese ulingisa ngaphandle kokukhuluma. Iqembu lakho liqagela amakhadi amaningi ngangokunokwenzeka ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi. Owuqala ukufinyelela inani elibekiwe uyawina.

IZIHLOKO EZI-11, AMAKHADI ANGAPHEZU KWE-800
Izihloko ezilula, ezilungele izingane nomdlalo wokuqala:
• Izilwane, Imisebenzi, Ezemidlalo, Izenzo zansuku zonke, Ukudla neziphuzo: amagama alula noma ubani angawalingisa
Kwabalingisi abanolwazi:
• Izisho: izisho zangempela ezifana "Izandla ziyagezana" noma "Inkonjane eyodwa ayilethi ihlobo", ezilingiswa ngokwezwi nezwi.
• Izigcawu ezihlekisayo: izigcawu ezimangazayo ezifana "Isiqhwaga sidlala i-poker" noma "Ivampire lishiswa yilanga".
• Amafilimu, izincwadi nezingoma: izihloko ezidumile ongazilingisa.
• Iziphicaphicwano zamagama: amagama ahlukaniswe ngemisindo ongayilingisa.
Izigcawu ezihlekisayo neZiphicaphicwano zamagama nazo zinezinguqulo ezinzima: Izindaba ezihlekisayo neZiphicaphicwano zamagama (okunzima).

YAKHIWE EMATHENJENI
• 2 abadlali, noma amaqembu amaningi.
• Engeza amaqembu nabadlali ngemizuzwana eyishumi, noma sebenzisa amagama engqondweni.
• Isikhathi somjikelezo sisuka kumasekhondi angu-30 kuya ku-90, khetha inani lokuwina.
• Isikrini sokudlulisa ifoni sikhombisa ubani okumele adlale, ukuze akuboni.
• Uma ubambe ikhadi, ungasilula, akukho sijeziso.
• I-haptics ne-confetti njalo uma iqembu lakho lithola impumelelo.

IDLALA NGOLIMI LAKHO
Mimesis ilandela ulimi lwefoni yakho ngokuzenzakalelayo: amakhadi neziphicaphicwano kuguqulelwe kulolo limi, futhi izisho ziyizisho zangempela zezwe lakho, hhayi ukuhumusha igama negama.

AKUKHO IZIMFUNDO EZIBOPHELE
• Mahhala, alikho ukukhangisa
• Alikho i-akhawunti, alikho ukubhalisa
• Iyasebenza offline ngemva kokulanda okokuqala
• Open source

Ifanele imicimbi yokuzalwa, amaholide, imihlangano yomndeni, ama-sleepover, ukwakha amaqembu noma ubusuku obunomoya. Kulula izingane, kuyahlekisa abadala.

Imithetho ifinyelela esigabeni esisodwa: akukho ukukhuluma, akukho ukuhlabela, akukho ukubhala, akukho ukukhomba izinto. Okusele kuxhomeke ekusebenzeni kwakho.

Thatha ifoni, hlanganisa abangane, bese umdlalo uqala!
